text:
External Auditor: Hi Redwood team — during our SOC 2 review we found a gap in archive metadata for tenant `tenant-X` covering 2023-11-01..2023-11-30. We need: chain-of-custody evidence, the exact export/playbook used to pull access logs, KMS/HSM wrap/unwrap audit entries, and a short repro so we can confirm how TTLs were enforced. Can you provide what you would deliver for an auditor bundle?

jess_support: Thanks — assigning. Pinging eng-sre and security. I'll coordinate the bundle and upload to the secure share when ready.

sam_oncall: ack — can pick this up today. Quick Q: do you want raw S3 objects or a normalized CSV + tarball?

External Auditor: Raw objects with checksums preferred; a mapping CSV is fine. Also include which fields were redacted (if any) and the sampling plan you used. We expect reproducible steps.

ryan_sre: Short repro steps we use internally — will include in bundle, pasting quick summary here: 
1) Query internal logs index for tenant and date range: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://logs-internal/api/v1/query?q=tenant:tenant-X AND timestamp:[2023-11-01T00:00:00Z TO 2023-11-30T23:59:59Z]" > tenant-X-2023-11.json
```
2) Export S3 prefix to staging host and archive: 
```
aws s3 sync s3://prod-audit-logs/tenant-X/2023-11 /tmp/tenant-X-2023-11
tar -czf tenant-X-2023-11.tar.gz -C /tmp tenant-X-2023-11
sha256sum tenant-X-2023-11.tar.gz > tenant-X-2023-11.sha256
```
3) Keystore snapshot & manifest: 
```
keystore-manifest --snapshot --tenant tenant-X --since 2023-10-31 --out keystore-tenant-X-2023-11.json
```
4) HSM/KMS audit pull (signed by HSM vendor): request audit export from HSM appliance, include envelope wrap/unwrap events for the wrapped DEKs used by tenant-X keys.

ryan_sre: I'll attach the exact commands and the internal playbook file as part of the evidence bundle.

maria_sec: For the KMS/HSM artifacts: we'll include vendor-signed audit entries (timestamps + event ids) and the key manifest (ARNs). Note: some key IDs will be partially redacted for customer privacy; we'll add a mapping file that shows which characters were removed. Also we'll include our access-control audit (who requested the export and which IAM identities accessed the bundle).

External Auditor: We also need change logs showing TTL policy edits during Oct–Nov 2023 and who made them. And a way to demonstrate TTL enforcement (i.e., a dry-run that lists objects that would have been deleted as of a date).

archi_lee: TTL enforcement repro approach: we have a dry-run script that simulates the lifecycle engine against a given as_of date. Example: 
```
python scripts/replay_ttl.py --tenant tenant-X --as_of 2023-12-01 --dry-run --output ttl-repro-2023-12-01.csv
```
The output lists object keys, policy version, creation date, and action (expire/keep). If you want proof of actual deletes, that's destructive and needs exec-approval / compliance sign-off.

jess_support: I'll assemble: 
- tenant-X-2023-11.tar.gz + .sha256
- keystore-tenant-X-2023-11.json (manifest)
- HSM-signed-audit-entries-tenant-X-2023-11.json
- ttl-repro-2023-12-01.csv (dry-run)
- change-log-ttl-Oct-Nov-2023.csv (who/when)
- README.md explaining redactions + mapping.csv
We will upload to the secure share and post the link here. ETA EOD 2023-12-02 PST.

External Auditor: Please include chain-of-custody notes (who accessed which files and timestamps) and a sampling plan: we will sample 5 objects per week across the period. Also confirm whether any KMS key ids are redacted in the HSM export.

sam_oncall: We'll generate presigned S3 URLs valid 7 days for the auditor to pull samples. We'll also include checksums for each sample and a signed manifest.

ryan_sre: FYI there was a short-lived 503 spike on 2023-11-12 02:14 UTC affecting API routing — we preserved the incident logs in `s3://incident-exports/INC-20231112-503/`. I'll include that path in the bundle in case it correlates with missing entries.

maria_sec: I'll prepare the vendor attestation and a short statement describing HSM redaction rules.

External Auditor: Thanks. Please post the secure link in this thread when ready and confirm if any log redaction removed KMS key ids (we need to know if we can match wrap/unwrap events to key ARNs).

jess_support: Will do. We'll note redactions in README and provide the mapping table. Posting updates here as soon as upload completes.

sam_oncall: :thumbsup:
